name: Martial Instinct 👊
source: Looking for a fight, the young woman finds an opponent worthy of her martial arts skills. But a few moments into grappling with him, they both realize they don’t want to fight. They want to fuck! He has two sets of hands to twist and turn her sexy body, and find all the erogenous zones all at once.
translation: 渴望痛快打上一场的年轻女武者，终于遇上了一位配得上自己一身武艺的劲敌。然而两人刚交手缠斗没几招，便双双意识到彼此想要的根本不是比武——而是上床！拥有两双手臂的他肆意揉弄摆布着她火辣的身躯，同时精准抚遍她浑身上下每一处敏感带。
